theorems.name: Submission.gwe_gjb_det_one_add_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ), Matrix.IsSymm G → (∀ x : Fin n → ℝ, 0 ≤ dotProduct x (Matrix.mulVec G x)) → 1 ≤ Matrix.det ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + G) ∧ Matrix.det ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + G) ≤ Real.exp (Matrix.trace G)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
